    AI Overview
    "The Neighbor from Hell" refers to various media, most notably a
    2026 ABC 20/20 true crime episode investigating the 2023 fatal shooting of Ajike Owens by her neighbor in Florida. It is also a popular contemporary romance book series by R.L. Mathewson and a video game series. 
    Key Associations 
    • True Crime - ABC 20/20 (April 3, 2026): Investigates the case of Susan Lorincz, who shot her neighbor, Ajike Owens, through a door in Ocala, Florida.
    • Book Series by R.L. Mathewson: A popular New York Times bestselling contemporary romance series known for humor and "enemies to lovers" tropes.
    • Video Games: Neighbours from Hell is a strategy game series where players play pranks on an angry neighbor. 
    Other "Neighbor from Hell" Contexts 
    • Real-life Harassment: The term is often used to describe severe harassment cases, such as the 2021 case of a Minnesota woman accused of stalking, harassment, and biting a dog.
    • Fiction: Neighbors from Hell (2010), an animated television series about demons living in Texas. 
    For the specific 20/20 documentary episode, it is available to stream on Hulu and Disney+.
